major_findings: Crossbow hunting now 60% of archery harvest (rapid growth trend)
CWD Management Area covers 7 western counties with transport restrictions
Deal Island & Fairmount WMAs offer permit-based impoundment hunting
4 active lottery systems: bear, chesapeake forest tract, mentored hunts, pheasant
Junior hunter participation up 12% YoY with free annual licenses
Sunday hunting permits in 7 counties (9,459 harvest 2024-25)
Apprentice license available ($15-$40) with mandatory safety course
Disabled veteran lifetime licenses are FREE (with VA certification)

Review individual WMA pages for unique access rules
